{"command": "git commit -F - <<'EOF'
feat(discount): add SPRING15 code and make codes case-insensitive

Add SPRING15 (15% off) to the CODES table in src/discount.js.

Normalize the incoming code with String(code).toUpperCase() before the
lookup, so "spring15" and "SPRING15" resolve to the same rate. Before
this, lookup was exact-match, so a lowercase code silently got no
discount. This applies to all codes, including WELCOME10 and VIP20.
Non-string input is coerced to a string and falls through to a 0 rate.

Tests (test/discount.test.js):
- SPRING15 takes 15% off (200 -> 170)
- codes are case-insensitive ("spring15" -> 170)

No expiry handling is included; SPRING15 is valid until removed from
CODES.

Sade dil (teknik olmayan biri için):
- Ne yapıldı: Müşteriler artık ödeme sırasında SPRING15 koduyla %15
  indirim alabiliyor. Kod büyük ya da küçük harfle yazılsa da çalışıyor.
- Ne işe yarar: Bahar kampanyası kodu kullanılabilir hale geldi. "spring15"
  yazan müşteri artık "kod geçersiz" gibi sessizce indirimsiz fiyat görmüyor.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Commit `fdfec46` is on `main`: `feat(discount): add SPRING15 code and make codes case-insensitive`. I did not push.

- **Tests:** `test/discount.test.js` was modified but not staged, so I staged it to go in with the code. All 4 tests pass when run on that file. `npm test` (`node --test`) wasn't run. Passing the `test/` directory to `node --test` failed, so I ran the file directly.
- **Case-insensitivity:** Your diff also made all codes case-insensitive, not only SPRING15. I put that in the message body because it changes `WELCOME10` and `VIP20` too.
- **Expiry:** The message says there is no expiry handling. Your `scratch.log` note says to ask Priya about expiry dates, so that's still open.
- **`scratch.log`:** Left untracked and out of the commit.
- **Message format:** I added the plain-language Turkish section from your CLAUDE.md, and left out the automation-impact line because this change doesn't reduce manual work.
